source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 648 replaces the JavaScript folder-wide callback with the DB view command. In nsMsgSearchDBView, markAllRead is converted to markMessagesRead and the selection is built from every current view index. The indices are then partitioned by their source folder. This keeps a Quick Filter or virtual search operation scoped to its displayed results instead of marking every message in every backing folder. The same routing remains in the fixed accepted source. No focused regression test was added in this landing, and a scoped search of test_nsMsgDBView.js did not establish this exact command case.
title: Apply Mark All Read to the displayed search results
